answer: An identity earns its seat through escrowed reward released only after appeal window, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. One honest agent clears the check in 14 minutes; a farm of 429 pays 6006 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. One beacon of signal, one fable of cost, one wander of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
